risks.title: Risk of non-compliance with data protection and privacy laws
risks.summary: The company and its partners must comply with stringent and evolving data protection and privacy regulations. Failure to comply could result in regulatory sanctions, litigation, fines, operational disruptions, and loss of revenue.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly stated with strong language (stringent and evolving laws). The company and its third-party partners must meet strict obligations. Non-compliance could lead to regulatory investigations, litigation, and substantial fines. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cyberattack risk compromising IT systems or data
risks.summary: A compromise of IT systems or data could disrupt operations, clinical trials, harm reputation, and lead to regulatory investigations, litigation, and fines.
risks.score_rationale: The text describes severe consequences (adverse consequences, interruptions to operations or clinical trials, reputational harm, litigation). The board of directors and audit committee provide active oversight. This represents a direct threat to operational continuity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Patent infringement litigation for NUPLAZID
risks.summary: Patent infringement lawsuits are ongoing for NUPLAZID (pimavanserin). The uncertain outcome of these litigations could undermine commercial protection and revenue from the key product.
risks.score_rationale: Multiple active litigations mentioned (MSN, Aurobindo, Zydus) with appeals pending at the Federal Circuit. NUPLAZID is a key commercial product generating a significant portion of revenue. The uncertain outcome could affect the product's patent protection. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Securities class action lawsuit
risks.summary: A class action alleges material omission of information regarding a regulatory filing, potentially leading to substantial damages and reputational harm.
risks.score_rationale: Action classified with discovery completed and pre-trial procedures ongoing. High risk of monetary damages or required governance reforms. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Shareholder derivative litigation
risks.summary: A derivative action sues executives for breach of fiduciary duty. A settlement is under negotiation.
risks.score_rationale: Derivative action ongoing but stayed. Preliminary agreement on $1.5M in attorney fees. Less impactful than other litigations but reflects governance risks. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Reliance on third parties for cybersecurity and compliance
risks.summary: Security breaches or compliance violations at external partners could lead to data breaches, operational disruptions, and regulatory sanctions for ACAD.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicit in the source: third-party partners must meet the same obligations as the company. Breaches at partners directly impact ACAD from regulatory and operational standpoints. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: ACAD does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in the business, MD&A, or risk sections of the 10-K report reviewed. The focus remains on traditional drug development and commercialization.
